result.title: Fitting Vision Adapters at Frontier Scales
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment
result.summary: Training a small projector between a frozen vision encoder and language model is an established approach to multimodal learning. As the parameter count of language models scales dramatically, we revisit which vision capabilities this approach can add while keeping their pretrained weights fixed. Here we train a 50M parameter projector from the vision encoder of Kimi K2.6 to GLM 5.2 and 5.3, both models without native vision capabilities, and further present a reproducible recipe for training these adapters at scale. We study the following: (a) how vision capabilities of multimodal models scale as purely the language model side scales, and (b) what specific vision capabilities are able to be imbued into a pure language model at scale, and which ones remain limited. We evaluate on MMMU-Pro and BLINK, examining both overall performance and results on individual visual tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在冻结视觉编码器与语言模型之间训练约 50M 参数的投影器（vision adapter），把视觉接入纯文本大模型，并系统考察随语言模型规模增大时哪些视觉能力可被注入、哪些仍受限。
AI.relevance_reason: 其任务级能力清单（MMMU-Pro、BLINK 分任务结果）可供核查哪些视觉信息需保留在内部表示中、哪些能力在「视觉旁路、只靠适配器传递」时受限，与视觉证据保留和表示坍缩的问题相关，但未涉及 latent 推理状态。
